test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The finance minister will announce the budget.

options.text: The budget will have announced by the finance minister.
The budget were announced by the finance minister.
The budget are announced by the finance minister.
The budget will be announced by the finance minister.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The budget will be announced by the finance minister'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The finance minister'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the budget'. 
 
• Since a modal verb has been used in the active voice, therefore, the passive voice will follow the given structure:-
 
 
• Active Voice - **Subject** + modal verb*(will) *+ V1 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice - **Object(Subjective form)** modal verb*(will)* + be + V3 Subject (Objective form).
 
 
 
• Here, 'will announce' is changed into 'will be annunced' because in the 'active to passive' transformation **third form of the verb** is used. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. 

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *The budget will be announced by the finance minister.*
